title: Sign Hacking with Auxiliary Variable Exploration in the Age of Big Data
summary: In linear regression, the signs of coefficients convey the direction of covariate effects and are central to empirical interpretation. In high-dimensional settings, however, the abundance of candidate covariates introduces substantial model selection uncertainty. We study the deliberate manipulation of coefficient signs through the inclusion of a carefully chosen auxiliary variable, a practice we term SHAVE (\textit{Sign Hacking with Auxiliary Variable Exploration}).
